n0f15e55418.headline: Complaints did not help, Pilný will not increase ministers' salaries. Government approved budget with a deficit of 50 billion | Aktuálně.cz
n0f15e55418.summary: The Czech government approved a budget with a 50 billion CZK deficit as proposed by former finance minister Andrej Babiš, deciding not to increase ministers' salaries despite complaints.
n0f15e55418.why: Government budgets and deficits influence fiscal policy, public spending, and economic stability in the Czech Republic.

n3e3bbced31.headline: Czechs invented a better way to access oil. Revolutionary method by scientists from Brno can also be used on the Moon | Aktuálně.cz
n3e3bbced31.summary: Scientists from Brno developed a new method to access oil that shortens exploration time from years to days, with potential applications even on the Moon.
n3e3bbced31.why: Innovations in oil exploration can reduce costs and increase efficiency in energy production.
